answers.core: It should be part of the core OS module.  There is a downside, I'll admit: every time you recompile the binary output would be a few bytes different.  I don't know if there is an easy work-around.  It could be one of the export options.
answers.workaround: While we're here, a `get_isodatetime_from_datetime()` would be quite handy.  Or, since it can probably done using a string % operator in one complicated line, why not include that line in the docs in lieu of giving us the function?
